title: tolvi doctor vault-health --json output
description: The machine-readable form of `tolvi doctor vault-health`: the content scan, its findings, and the grade per dimension. Findings are always an array, empty when a vault is clean, so a consumer never has to special-case null.

tolvi_version.description: The CLI that produced this output, as `tolvi version` reports it. 'dev' for an unreleased build.

vault_path.description: Absolute path of the vault that was scanned.

files_scanned.description: Documents read, including those whose frontmatter could not be parsed.

overall_grade.description: Letter grade for the vault as a whole, for example 'A+' or 'B-'.

high_severity.description: Count of high-severity findings. `tolvi doctor vault-health` exits non-zero when this is above zero; medium and low findings are advisory.

grades.description: One entry per scored dimension, keyed by dimension name.

findings.description: Every defect found, in report order. Empty for a clean vault.

check_id.description: Which check produced the finding, for example 'empty-tags' or 'duplicate-title'.

file.description: Path of the document the finding is about, relative to the vault.

reason.description: What is wrong, phrased for a person.
